engine.name: y0
engine.identity_rule: Commit and saved source hashes control this design. A development version string is not an environment lock or a claim about any later release.
engine.preferred_decision: Integrate the pinned ID path through a restricted adapter; do not port the whole engine. Native IDC is withheld pending resolution of the documented separation counterexample.

scope.initial_target: One outcome Y and one treatment A in the inherited scalar target contract, with an optional finite set of conditioning variables Z. Identify the distribution P(Y | do(A), Z), retaining treatment/control values separately for a later contrast.
scope.domains: Declared finite discrete state spaces for this first adapter and its independent numerical references. Wider symbolic or continuous use requires a separately reviewed measure and evaluation contract.
scope.identification_model: A supplied causal DAG or semi-Markovian ADMG over observed variables, with a single observational joint law. The graph and causal interpretation are assumptions supplied by the caller, not established by y0.
scope.completeness_limit: The joint-ID route for conditional queries is sufficient when successful but does not establish completeness for conditional identification. Its failure is unsupported, not proof that the requested conditional effect is unidentified.

shared_contract.rule: These are proposed surfaces using the same core request and response, not implemented endpoints. The request context hash, engine identity, graph identity and result are identical across transports.
shared_contract.raw_data: No account rows are needed by this symbolic operation. Graph/query/context artifacts are resolved through authorized handles with checked hashes; no arbitrary URL, path or executable expression is accepted.

request_preservation.identity: Bind the complete normalized scientific request with context_digest from the inherited contract, plus an adapter schema/version digest and engine commit. Preserve the original context verbatim in an immutable artifact.
request_preservation.target_values: Keep treated and control state labels in caller order and verify domain membership. An ID formula is indexed by the treatment symbol, not a numerical difference. Reversing the contrast changes the request identity.
request_preservation.conditions: Validate disjoint Y, A and Z, graph membership and any supplied condition values. Preserve all three query fields independently of the engine's Query.expression convenience property.
request_preservation.population_and_sampling: Retain cluster, panel, time, audit, weight and selection declarations. Symbolic identification supplies no iid sampling assertion or uncertainty formula. A request whose context requires interference, selection correction, longitudinal regime identification or multiple source laws is unsupported in this path.
request_preservation.clock: Retain observation time, availability time, decision time, horizon and time-zone/ordering declarations. A post-treatment condition may define a different target; it is never silently promoted to a baseline adjustment variable.
request_preservation.units: Retain outcome units, support coordinates, treatment units, horizon and currency/scaling conventions. Probability functionals are dimensionless. Expectations or currency contrasts require a separate evaluator and retain original support values and sign. No automatic USD conversion or probability-to-benefit conversion.
request_preservation.names_and_coordinates: Create a bijection from opaque external variable IDs to V0000, V0001, ... in canonical external-ID order. Preserve external labels, domain order, time coordinates and units in a sidecar. Detect duplicate IDs and collisions before conversion. No parsing causal roles from names.

validation: All nodes and edge endpoints must be declared; no self edge, duplicate edge of the same type, circle endpoint or tail-tail edge.
Tail-arrow maps to its directed orientation; arrow-tail maps to the reverse orientation; arrow-arrow maps only to an ADMG bidirected edge.
DAG requests cannot have bidirected edges. ADMG directed components must be acyclic; allow an arrow and bidirected edge on the same pair (a bow).
Compute a deterministic valid topological order on the directed component, resolving ties by internal symbol ID, and validate any supplied order.
Pass every node, including isolated nodes, explicitly to NxMixedGraph.from_edges; pass empty edge lists explicitly for an edgeless graph.
Compare the converted node set and typed edge sets with the request before calling ID. Keep the original graph artifact and its hash.
graph_conversion.mapping: NxMixedGraph.from_edges(nodes=all_symbols, directed=directed_pairs, undirected=bidirected_pairs). The engine's undirected field represents bidirected latent links here. A CPDAG undirected edge cannot be mapped into it.
graph_conversion.set_topology: A graph set is preserved as a set in the rejected request and returned explanation; no single representative is selected. No uncomputed effect region becomes a point, empty set or finite interval. If a generic result schema demands a set, use topology=unknown and intervals=null.

dispatch.unconditional: Call identify_outcomes(graph, treatments={A}, outcomes={Y}, conditions=None, strict=True, ordering=validated_order).
dispatch.conditional: Call the same ID path with outcomes={Y} union Z and conditions=None. Convert the returned joint functional N to a typed AST. Form ratio(N, marginalize(N, {Y})) in the adapter's typed representation. This represents P(Y,Z | do(A)) / P(Z | do(A)) on positive conditional support.
dispatch.conditional_support: Attach P(Z=z | do(A=a)) > 0 and required observed-law support conditions. A zero numerical denominator in a future evaluator is unsupported for that coordinate, never zero or infinity by convention.
dispatch.no_native_idc: Do not call the pinned native IDC route. The inspected rule-2 separation path does not correctly handle the retained bidirected-collider example. Re-enable only after an independently reviewed correction and actual engine regression evidence.
dispatch.strict_errors: Catch Unidentifiable separately from ValueError, KeyError, ordering errors, dependency errors, resource exhaustion and internal exceptions. Never convert all exceptions to not_identified.
dispatch.unconditional_nonidentification: A scoped native Unidentifiable gives completed/not_identified with engine-reported diagnostic provenance, original graph and query. It is conditional on admitted model/engine validation; do not label raw exception arguments an independently checked hedge certificate.
dispatch.conditional_failure: If joint ID fails, return completed/unsupported with CONDITIONAL_JOINT_ROUTE_FAILED; native IDC or other methods might identify the conditional query. No claim that the conditional target itself is unidentified.

expression_conversion.format: A versioned, non-executable AST: probability(children, given, source_law), product(factors), marginalize(body, bound_variables), ratio(numerator, denominator), one and zero. Every variable token maps to the preserved symbol table.
expression_conversion.scope_check: Reject unknown subclasses, residual counterfactual/intervention atoms or unrecognized operators in an observational ID functional. Do not silently drop them or evaluate to_y0 output as Python.
expression_conversion.binding: Each Sum is a lexical binding scope. Alpha-rename dummy variables before serialization so a summed treatment in an inner front-door term cannot capture the free outer treatment. Preserve factor structure and denominator conditions; do not substitute strings globally.
expression_conversion.equality: Normalized AST identity permits commutative factor ordering and alpha-renaming but is not a general symbolic equivalence decision. Engine text/LaTeX is display-only and must be escaped. Keep the original expression artifact for diagnosis.
expression_conversion.semantic_roundtrip: Deserialize the AST and check query triple, free-variable roles, variable/domain coordinates, graph hash, units, sampling declarations and exact oracle evaluations. A matching rendered formula alone is insufficient.

response_contract.computed: completed/computed; result kind=identified_functional, original_query, engine identity, graph/context hashes, typed AST, support assumptions and provenance. qualification=execution_only only after actual engine admission; never infer a confidence interval, graph truth or bank qualification.
response_contract.numeric_fields: point_estimate=null, standard_error=null, confidence_set=null for this symbolic operation.
response_contract.not_identified: Completed negative scientific disposition only for unconditional ID within its admitted scope; evidence states whether the diagnostic is merely engine-reported or independently verified.

statuses.action: Preserve the complete graph/class. Supply a separately justified single graph or use a graph-set method.
Route dynamic, selection, transport, counterfactual or continuous-evaluation queries to a separately reviewed method.
Return the offending IDs, marks, cycle or domain mismatch for correction.
Preserve the conditional target; obtain a qualified conditional-identification route or additional assumptions/information.
Retain opaque expression identity and offending class; extend and validate the AST converter before retrying.
Install the reviewed isolated environment and verify all artifact hashes; never substitute a fixture engine.
Report wall/memory/output limit and preserve all-request accounting. A larger reviewed budget is a new attempt.
Return a durable cancelled state and no partial scientific result; retain a complete result if publication already won the race.
Preserve sanitized diagnostic and exact engine identity for investigation; do not report nonidentification.

deployment.optional_r_extra: rpy2; not needed for the proposed pure-Python ID path
deployment.test_group_distinction: Upstream test groups include pgmpy, xgboost, torch, y0[r] and matplotlib. Their declaration does not make all of them runtime requirements for this selected path.
deployment.remaining_environment_work: The saved complete tree has no root uv.lock/poetry.lock. No transitive version resolution, wheel/source build, installation or import trial was performed. Before admission, freeze Python/platform, build tools, all direct/transitive versions and distribution hashes, collect their license notices, and record actual build/import logs.
deployment.isolation: Propose a separately provisioned local worker with no network need during symbolic calls. Enforce wall, memory and output budgets at the worker boundary; no claim that the y0 API itself provides cancellation/deadline guarantees.
deployment.license: Saved BSD 3-clause text permits source/binary redistribution with or without modification subject to retained copyright/conditions/disclaimer and nonendorsement. Preserve required notices. This license does not certify dependencies or causal validity.
deployment.rollout: Admission starts with bounded DAG/unconditional ADMG and the conservative conditional joint-ID route. Failed cases stay in the ledger. Native IDC and other engines remain independent future decisions.

independent_references.execution_kind: Exact rational project arithmetic; zero random draws; no downloaded engine executed
independent_references.frontdoor: A->M->Y with A<->Y: generated intervention means 13/40 and 23/40; independent observational functional equals both; effect 1/4, naive difference 37/100. A declared hypothetical USD1000 per success makes the gross difference USD250 before costs.
independent_references.bow: Two allowed-edge SCMs with the same strictly positive observed P(A,Y) have effects 3/5 and 0. This is an independent nonidentification reference.
independent_references.bidirected_collider: Y<->B<->Z with isolated X: P(Y=1 | B=1,Z=1)=9/10, while P(Y=1 | B=1,do(Z=1))=1/2. The inspected separation trace would allow an invalid rule-2 exchange; joint-ID normalization preserves the conditional target.

required_admission_examples: Actual pinned engine ID on a DAG back-door case, the front-door oracle and the nonidentified bow; save exact returned expression/exception and logs.
Conditional collider via joint-ID normalization with original intervention and both conditions preserved; evaluate exact positive tables and compare 9/10.
Isolated nodes survive graph conversion; bidirected edges and directed/bidirected bows remain distinct; cycles, unknown nodes, overlapping roles and malformed domains reject.
CPDAG/PAG/graph-set requests preserve their topology and return unsupported with no numerical effect.
AST roundtrip handles front-door dummy-treatment binding, nested ratios, variable renaming/permutation, label collisions, support zeros and unknown expression nodes.
Unconditional Unidentifiable, conditional joint-ID failure, internal exception, cancellation and timeout have distinct retained dispositions.

Library/CLI/MCP invoke the identical core context and response; sign, domain coordinates, calendar units and sampling declaration roundtrip unchanged. This is a future transport trial, not executed here.
review_limits: Passing this design does not satisfy IN.ADAPTER.Python or confer integration_allowed/engine_executed capability.
Native IDC concerns are source-traced and supported by an independent SCM counterexample, not an observed upstream runtime failure.
No fitted effect, confidence calibration, live model, commercial execution, bank validation or sibling repository execution occurred.
